name: Song With Lag
description: When the game lags, the song lags with it, so the level and the music stay in sync.

enabled.name: Song lags with the game
enabled.description: When a frame takes too long, the level moves on by one ordinary frame instead of jumping ahead, and whenever the song drifts away from the level - ahead or behind - it is moved back to match.

threshold-ms.name: Lag threshold (ms)
threshold-ms.description: A frame longer than this counts as lag. At 60 FPS an ordinary frame is about 17 ms; on a high refresh rate screen you can lower this.

tolerance-ms.name: Sync tolerance (ms)
tolerance-ms.description: The song is moved only when it drifts further than this from the level, ahead or behind. Each move makes the sound skip slightly, so raise this if you hear it skipping when nothing lagged.

show-info.name: Show sync info
show-info.description: When a level starts, pops up "Song With Lag is on", and while playing keeps a small line at the bottom of the screen: how far the song is from the level, how many frames lagged and how many times the song was moved. If the pop-up never appears, the mod is not loaded.

check-updates.name: Check for updates
check-updates.description: Downloads the newest release straight from GitHub. Restart the game afterwards to apply it.
